overviewParagraphs: Custom PVC patches are made from soft, flexible polyvinyl chloride — a rubber-like material injected into custom molds. The result is a durable, waterproof patch with a distinctive modern appearance. Good for flexible and weather-resistant branding.

features.title: Extreme Durability
features.description: PVC patches are made from soft, flexible rubber that withstands weather, abrasion, washing and heavy use.

features.title: Waterproof & Weatherproof
features.description: Unlike fabric-based patches, PVC is inherently waterproof — perfect for outdoor gear and all-weather applications.

features.title: Bold 2D & 3D Relief
features.description: PVC patches can be produced in 2D or 3D, creating a striking dimensional effect.

features.title: Modern Technical Look
features.description: The clean, rubberized look appeals to tactical, outdoor, sports and streetwear brands.

typeOptions.title: Adhesive

faqs.question: What are PVC patches made of?
faqs.answer: PVC patches are made from soft polyvinyl chloride — a flexible, rubber-like material injected into custom molds. The result is a durable, waterproof patch with a distinctive modern appearance.

faqs.question: 2D vs 3D PVC?
faqs.answer: 2D PVC patches have a flat surface with recessed color areas. 3D PVC patches have raised elements at different heights, creating a sculptural effect.

faqs.question: Are PVC patches waterproof?
faqs.answer: Yes. PVC is inherently waterproof and weatherproof, making these patches ideal for outdoor gear and products exposed to elements.

faqs.question: What backing works best?
faqs.answer: Velcro backing is the most popular for PVC patches, especially for tactical and outdoor applications. Sew-on and adhesive are also available.

faqs.question: How do I get a quote?
faqs.answer: Upload your artwork via our Request a Quote page. We respond with a detailed quote — typically within 1 business day.
